versions.content: Service Name Dem_SetDataOfPID21 Syntax Std_ReturnType Dem_SetDataOfPID21 ( const uint8 * PID21value ) Service ID [hex] 0xa6 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) PID21value Buffer containing the contents of PID $21. The buffer is provided by the Dcm with the appropriate size, i.e. during configuration, the Dcm identifies the required size from the largest PID in order to configure a PIDBuffer. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType Always E_OK is returned, as E_NOT_OK will never appear. Description Service to set the value of PID $21 in the Dem by a software component. API is needed in OBD-relevant ECUs only. API Availability: This API will be available only if ({ecuc(Dem/DemGeneral.DemOBDSupport)} != DEM_OBD_NO_OBD_SUPPORT) Available via Dem.h
